plotEn: Antoinette is a lonely fan of fading star Blake De Troy. After attempts to revitalize his career fall flat, Blake decides to visit his one remaining fan. When his limousine crashes into a swamp, he is rescued by Antoinette. Bruised and believing he has been kidnapped, Blake tries to escape, only to learn that Antoinette is a veterinary technician who is nursing him back to health. When a studio calls with an offer on condition that he becomes topical, Blake hatches a plan to use the "kidnapping" to relaunch his career and go viral.
